## Projects

- [Cat Food Calculator](https://joeconlin.org/projects/cat-food-calculator/) · [Markdown](https://joeconlin.org/projects/cat-food-calculator/index.md) · [Try it](https://calc.catrepairwoman.com) · [How to use it](https://catrepairwoman.com/how-to-use-cat-food-calculator/) · [Cat Repairwoman](https://catrepairwoman.com): A vet-designed calculator that works out how much to feed a cat, built for my wife’s channel, Cat Repairwoman.
- [Whisker & Claw](https://joeconlin.org/projects/whisker-and-claw/) · [Markdown](https://joeconlin.org/projects/whisker-and-claw/index.md) · [Play it](https://vet-game-six.vercel.app): A browser game where you run a cat-only vet clinic like a tabletop RPG, and a d20 decides how cleanly your medicine goes.
- [VFD Maker](https://joeconlin.org/projects/vfd-maker/) · [Markdown](https://joeconlin.org/projects/vfd-maker/index.md) · [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/joeconlin/vfd-image-maker): A browser tool for composing and exporting images in the style of a Roland JX-8P display.
- [Patchbook](https://joeconlin.org/projects/patchbook/) · [Markdown](https://joeconlin.org/projects/patchbook/index.md): A local-first studio reference app for equipment, patches, manuals, and project notes.
- [Pizza Scorecard](https://joeconlin.org/projects/pizza-scorecard/) · [Markdown](https://joeconlin.org/projects/pizza-scorecard/index.md) · [Try it](https://pizza-ranking-frontend.vercel.app) · [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/joeconlin/pizza-ranking-frontend): A small web app for scoring pizza spots on crust, sauce, cheese, and overall flavor, with a group leaderboard.
